purpose: Add a connected statement or the next development.
keywords: I ate breakfast. Then I left home.
This room is spacious. And it is bright.
He stood up. Then he began to speak.
restrictions: The link may be temporal or additive, depending on the surrounding text.
mistake: It does not necessarily mean the first event caused the second.
